theorems.name: Submission.cmcs_rc_pairing_integrable_abs_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (E K : Set (Euclid P)) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (ε : ℝ), AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → Continuous ω → MeasurableSet K → μ K < ∞ → (∀ x, x ∉ K → ω x = 0) → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x) ≤ ε) → Integrable (fun x => ξ x (ω x)) (μ.restrict E) ∧ |∫ x in E, ξ x (ω x) ∂μ| ≤ ε * (μ K).toReal
